title: Introduction to Modern C++
text:
C++ is a powerful, general-purpose programming language that supports multiple programming paradigms. 
It combines the efficiency of low-level languages with the abstraction capabilities of high-level languages. 

Modern C++ refers to C++11 and later standards, which introduced many features that make the language safer, more expressive, and easier to use. 
These features include auto type deduction, range-based for loops, smart pointers, lambda expressions, and more. 

The language continues to evolve with new standards like C++14, C++17, C++20, and C++23, each adding improvements and new capabilities.
textTranslate:
C++ 是一种强大的通用编程语言，支持多种编程范式。 
它结合了低级语言的效率和高级语言的抽象能力。 

现代 C++ 指的是 C++11 及以后的标准，引入了许多使语言更安全、更具表现力、更易用的特性。 
这些特性包括 auto 类型推导、基于范围的 for 循环、智能指针、lambda 表达式等。 

该语言继续发展，出现了 C++14、C++17、C++20 和 C++23 等新标准，每个标准都增加了改进和新功能。

title: The auto Keyword
text:
The auto keyword in C++11 allows the compiler to automatically deduce the type of a variable from its initializer. 
This reduces verbosity and makes code more maintainable. 

For example, instead of writing std::vector<int>::iterator it = vec.begin(), you can simply write auto it = vec.begin(). 
The compiler deduces that it is of type std::vector<int>::iterator. 

Auto follows the same type deduction rules as template type deduction. 
It strips away references and top-level const qualifiers, so auto x = 42 deduces int, not const int. 
To preserve const or reference, you can use const auto& or auto&&.
textTranslate:
C++11 中的 auto 关键字允许编译器从初始化器自动推导变量的类型。 
这减少了冗长性，使代码更易维护。 

例如，不必写 std::vector<int>::iterator it = vec.begin()，你可以简单地写 auto it = vec.begin()。 
编译器推导出 it 的类型是 std::vector<int>::iterator。 

Auto 遵循与模板类型推导相同的规则。 
它会去除引用和顶层 const 限定符，所以 auto x = 42 推导为 int，而不是 const int。 
要保留 const 或引用，可以使用 const auto& 或 auto&&。

title: Range-based For Loops
text:
Range-based for loops, introduced in C++11, provide a cleaner syntax for iterating over containers. 
Instead of manually managing iterators, you can iterate directly over the elements. 

The syntax is: for (declaration : range) { statements }. 
The range can be any container that provides begin() and end() iterators, or a C-style array. 

You can use auto to let the compiler deduce the element type, or specify it explicitly. 
To avoid copying, use const auto& for read-only access or auto& for modification. 
This makes code more readable and less error-prone than traditional iterator-based loops.
textTranslate:
C++11 引入的基于范围的 for 循环为遍历容器提供了更简洁的语法。 
不必手动管理迭代器，可以直接遍历元素。 

语法是：for (declaration : range) { statements }。 
范围可以是任何提供 begin() 和 end() 迭代器的容器，或 C 风格数组。 

可以使用 auto 让编译器推导元素类型，或显式指定。 
为避免复制，对只读访问使用 const auto&，对修改使用 auto&。 
这使代码比传统的基于迭代器的循环更易读且更不易出错。

title: Lambda Expressions
text:
Lambda expressions in C++11 provide a way to define anonymous functions inline. 
They are particularly useful with STL algorithms and for creating function objects on the fly. 

The basic syntax is: [capture](parameters) -> return_type { body }. 
The capture clause specifies which variables from the enclosing scope are accessible. 

You can capture by value [=], by reference [&], or selectively [x, &y]. 
Lambdas can be stored in variables using auto, or passed directly to functions. 
They are essentially syntactic sugar for function objects, but much more convenient to use.
textTranslate:
C++11 中的 lambda 表达式提供了一种内联定义匿名函数的方法。 
它们在与 STL 算法一起使用和即时创建函数对象时特别有用。 

基本语法是：[capture](parameters) -> return_type { body }。 
捕获子句指定可以从封闭作用域访问哪些变量。 

可以按值捕获 [=]，按引用捕获 [&]，或选择性捕获 [x, &y]。 
Lambda 可以使用 auto 存储在变量中，或直接传递给函数。 
它们本质上是函数对象的语法糖，但使用起来更方便。

title: Smart Pointers
text:
Smart pointers are RAII-compliant wrappers around raw pointers that automatically manage memory. 
They were introduced in C++11 to help prevent memory leaks and make memory management safer. 

There are three main types: std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr, and std::weak_ptr. 
unique_ptr represents exclusive ownership and cannot be copied, only moved. 
shared_ptr allows multiple pointers to share ownership of the same object. 
weak_ptr is a non-owning reference that doesn't affect the object's lifetime. 

Using smart pointers eliminates the need for manual new and delete, reducing the risk of memory leaks and dangling pointers.
textTranslate:
智能指针是围绕原始指针的符合 RAII 的包装器，可自动管理内存。 
它们在 C++11 中引入，以帮助防止内存泄漏并使内存管理更安全。 

主要有三种类型：std::unique_ptr、std::shared_ptr 和 std::weak_ptr。 
unique_ptr 表示独占所有权，不能复制，只能移动。 
shared_ptr 允许多个指针共享同一对象的所有权。 
weak_ptr 是非拥有引用，不影响对象的生命周期。 

使用智能指针消除了手动 new 和 delete 的需要，降低了内存泄漏和悬空指针的风险。

title: Move Semantics
text:
Move semantics, introduced in C++11, allows the efficient transfer of resources from one object to another. 
Instead of copying, which can be expensive, move semantics transfers ownership. 

An rvalue reference, denoted by &&, can bind to temporary objects. 
The move constructor and move assignment operator use rvalue references to efficiently transfer resources. 

std::move() converts an lvalue to an rvalue reference, enabling move semantics. 
After a move operation, the source object is left in a valid but unspecified state. 
Move semantics significantly improve performance by avoiding unnecessary copies of large objects.
textTranslate:
C++11 引入的移动语义允许高效地将资源从一个对象转移到另一个对象。 
不是复制（可能很昂贵），移动语义转移所有权。 

右值引用，用 && 表示，可以绑定到临时对象。 
移动构造函数和移动赋值运算符使用右值引用来高效地转移资源。 

std::move() 将左值转换为右值引用，启用移动语义。 
移动操作后，源对象处于有效但未指定的状态。 
移动语义通过避免不必要的大对象复制显著提高了性能。

title: Templates and Generic Programming
text:
Templates are C++'s mechanism for generic programming, allowing code to work with different types. 
A template is a blueprint for generating code at compile time. 

Function templates allow you to write a single function that works with multiple types. 
Class templates allow you to define classes that work with different types. 

Template specialization allows you to provide specific implementations for particular types. 
Variadic templates, introduced in C++11, allow templates to accept a variable number of arguments. 
Templates are powerful but can make code harder to read and debug, so use them judiciously.
textTranslate:
模板是 C++ 的泛型编程机制，允许代码与不同类型一起工作。 
模板是在编译时生成代码的蓝图。 

函数模板允许你编写一个适用于多种类型的函数。 
类模板允许你定义适用于不同类型的类。 

模板特化允许你为特定类型提供具体实现。 
C++11 引入的可变参数模板允许模板接受可变数量的参数。 
模板很强大，但可能使代码更难阅读和调试，因此要谨慎使用。

title: STL Containers and Algorithms
text:
The Standard Template Library (STL) provides a rich collection of containers, iterators, and algorithms. 
Containers store data, iterators provide access to elements, and algorithms operate on ranges. 

Common containers include vector, list, deque, map, set, and unordered_map. 
Each container has different performance characteristics and use cases. 

STL algorithms like std::sort, std::find, and std::transform work with iterators. 
They are generic and can work with any container that provides appropriate iterators. 
The separation of containers and algorithms through iterators is a key design principle of the STL.
textTranslate:
标准模板库（STL）提供了丰富的容器、迭代器和算法集合。 
容器存储数据，迭代器提供对元素的访问，算法对范围进行操作。 

常见容器包括 vector、list、deque、map、set 和 unordered_map。 
每个容器都有不同的性能特征和用例。 

像 std::sort、std::find 和 std::transform 这样的 STL 算法与迭代器一起工作。 
它们是泛型的，可以与任何提供适当迭代器的容器一起工作。 
通过迭代器分离容器和算法是 STL 的关键设计原则。

title: RAII and Resource Management
text:
RAII stands for Resource Acquisition Is Initialization, a fundamental C++ idiom. 
It ensures that resources are properly managed by tying their lifetime to object lifetime. 

When an object is created, it acquires resources. 
When the object is destroyed, it automatically releases those resources. 

This applies to any resource: memory, file handles, locks, network connections, etc. 
Smart pointers are a perfect example of RAII for memory management. 
RAII eliminates the need for manual resource management and makes code exception-safe. 
It's one of the most important principles in modern C++ programming.
textTranslate:
RAII 代表资源获取即初始化，是 C++ 的基本惯用法。 
它通过将资源生命周期与对象生命周期绑定来确保资源得到正确管理。 

创建对象时，它获取资源。 
销毁对象时，它自动释放这些资源。 

这适用于任何资源：内存、文件句柄、锁、网络连接等。 
智能指针是内存管理 RAII 的完美示例。 
RAII 消除了手动资源管理的需要，并使代码异常安全。 
它是现代 C++ 编程中最重要的原则之一。

title: Exception Handling
text:
Exception handling in C++ provides a mechanism for dealing with error conditions. 
It allows you to separate error handling code from normal program flow. 

The try block contains code that might throw exceptions. 
The catch block handles specific types of exceptions. 
You can have multiple catch blocks for different exception types. 

Functions that might throw exceptions should be marked with noexcept(false) or not marked at all. 
Functions guaranteed not to throw should be marked noexcept. 
Exception safety is important: operations should maintain invariants even when exceptions occur. 
The three levels of exception safety are: basic guarantee, strong guarantee, and no-throw guarantee.
textTranslate:
C++ 中的异常处理提供了处理错误条件的机制。 
它允许你将错误处理代码与正常程序流程分离。 

try 块包含可能抛出异常的代码。 
catch 块处理特定类型的异常。 
可以为不同的异常类型设置多个 catch 块。 

可能抛出异常的函数应标记为 noexcept(false) 或根本不标记。 
保证不抛出的函数应标记为 noexcept。 
异常安全很重要：即使发生异常，操作也应保持不变量。 
异常安全的三个级别是：基本保证、强保证和无抛出保证。

title: RAII: Deep Dive into Resource Management
text:
RAII is a fundamental C++ idiom that ensures resources are automatically managed through object lifetime. 
The core principle is: resource acquisition happens during object construction, and resource release happens during object destruction. 
This guarantees that resources are always properly cleaned up, even in the presence of exceptions. 

Consider a file handle wrapper class. The constructor opens the file, and the destructor closes it. 
When the object goes out of scope, the destructor is automatically called, ensuring the file is closed. 
This works even if an exception is thrown, because stack unwinding calls destructors for all local objects. 

RAII provides exception safety guarantees. 
If an exception occurs after resource acquisition but before release, RAII ensures cleanup happens. 
Without RAII, you'd need try-catch blocks around every resource usage, which is error-prone and verbose. 

Smart pointers are the most common RAII example. std::unique_ptr acquires memory in its constructor and releases it in its destructor. 
Similarly, std::lock_guard acquires a mutex in its constructor and releases it in its destructor. 
This pattern applies to any resource: database connections, network sockets, graphics contexts, etc. 

The rule of three (or five in C++11) is related to RAII. 
If you manage resources manually, you must implement copy constructor, copy assignment, and destructor. 
With RAII, the resource-managing class handles these automatically, making your code safer and simpler. 

RAII eliminates the need for explicit cleanup code and prevents resource leaks. 
It's one of the most important C++ idioms and should be used for all resource management.
textTranslate:
RAII 是 C++ 的基本惯用法，确保通过对象生命周期自动管理资源。 
核心原则是：资源获取发生在对象构造期间，资源释放发生在对象析构期间。 
这保证了资源总是被正确清理，即使在存在异常的情况下也是如此。 

考虑一个文件句柄包装类。构造函数打开文件，析构函数关闭文件。 
当对象超出作用域时，自动调用析构函数，确保文件被关闭。 
即使抛出异常，这也有效，因为栈展开会为所有局部对象调用析构函数。 

RAII 提供异常安全保证。 
如果在资源获取之后、释放之前发生异常，RAII 确保清理会发生。 
没有 RAII，你需要在每个资源使用周围使用 try-catch 块，这容易出错且冗长。 

智能指针是最常见的 RAII 示例。std::unique_ptr 在其构造函数中获取内存，在其析构函数中释放内存。 
类似地，std::lock_guard 在其构造函数中获取互斥锁，在其析构函数中释放互斥锁。 
这种模式适用于任何资源：数据库连接、网络套接字、图形上下文等。 

三法则（或 C++11 中的五法则）与 RAII 相关。 
如果你手动管理资源，必须实现拷贝构造函数、拷贝赋值运算符和析构函数。 
使用 RAII，资源管理类自动处理这些，使你的代码更安全、更简单。 

RAII 消除了显式清理代码的需要，并防止资源泄漏。 
它是 C++ 最重要的惯用法之一，应该用于所有资源管理。

title: Virtual Function Tables and Polymorphism
text:
Virtual function tables (vtables) are the mechanism that enables runtime polymorphism in C++. 
When a class declares virtual functions, the compiler creates a vtable for that class. 
The vtable is an array of function pointers, one for each virtual function. 

Each object with virtual functions contains a hidden pointer called the vptr (virtual pointer). 
The vptr points to the vtable for the object's actual type. 
When you call a virtual function, the compiler generates code that follows the vptr to find the correct function. 

Consider a base class Base with a virtual function foo(), and a derived class Derived that overrides it. 
Base has a vtable with one entry pointing to Base::foo(). 
Derived has its own vtable with an entry pointing to Derived::foo(). 
When you create a Derived object, its vptr points to Derived's vtable. 

When you call a virtual function through a base pointer, the compiler doesn't know the actual object type at compile time. 
Instead, it generates code that: loads the vptr, indexes into the vtable, and calls the function through the pointer. 
This indirection enables runtime polymorphism - the correct function is called based on the actual object type. 

Virtual function calls have a small performance overhead compared to non-virtual calls. 
They require an extra memory access (to load the vptr) and an indirect function call. 
However, this overhead is usually negligible compared to the flexibility polymorphism provides. 

Pure virtual functions make a class abstract. 
A class with pure virtual functions cannot be instantiated directly. 
The vtable entry for a pure virtual function typically points to a function that prints an error or terminates the program. 
Derived classes must override all pure virtual functions to be concrete. 

Multiple inheritance complicates vtables. 
A class with multiple base classes may have multiple vptrs, one for each base class with virtual functions. 
The compiler must ensure that each base class subobject has the correct vptr pointing to the appropriate vtable. 
This is why multiple inheritance can be more expensive than single inheritance.
textTranslate:
虚函数表（vtable）是 C++ 中实现运行时多态的机制。 
当类声明虚函数时，编译器为该类创建一个 vtable。 
Vtable 是一个函数指针数组，每个虚函数对应一个指针。 

每个具有虚函数的对象都包含一个称为 vptr（虚指针）的隐藏指针。 
Vptr 指向对象实际类型的 vtable。 
当你调用虚函数时，编译器生成代码，通过 vptr 找到正确的函数。 

考虑一个基类 Base，它有一个虚函数 foo()，以及一个派生类 Derived，它重写了该函数。 
Base 有一个 vtable，其中有一个条目指向 Base::foo()。 
Derived 有自己的 vtable，其中有一个条目指向 Derived::foo()。 
当你创建 Derived 对象时，它的 vptr 指向 Derived 的 vtable。 

当你通过基类指针调用虚函数时，编译器在编译时不知道实际对象类型。 
相反，它生成代码：加载 vptr，索引到 vtable，并通过指针调用函数。 
这种间接性实现了运行时多态——根据实际对象类型调用正确的函数。 

与非虚函数调用相比，虚函数调用有小的性能开销。 
它们需要额外的内存访问（加载 vptr）和间接函数调用。 
但是，与多态提供的灵活性相比，这种开销通常可以忽略不计。 

纯虚函数使类成为抽象类。 
具有纯虚函数的类不能直接实例化。 
纯虚函数的 vtable 条目通常指向打印错误或终止程序的函数。 
派生类必须重写所有纯虚函数才能成为具体类。 

多重继承使 vtable 复杂化。 
具有多个基类的类可能有多个 vptr，每个具有虚函数的基类对应一个。 
编译器必须确保每个基类子对象都有正确的 vptr 指向适当的 vtable。 
这就是为什么多重继承可能比单继承更昂贵。

title: Template Instantiation and Code Generation
titleTranslate: 模板实例化和代码生成
text:
Templates in C++ are a compile-time mechanism for generating code. 
When you use a template with specific types, the compiler generates a specialized version of that template. 
This process is called template instantiation. 

For example, if you have a template function max<T>(T a, T b), and you call max(5, 10), the compiler instantiates max<int>. 
Similarly, calling max(3.14, 2.71) instantiates max<double>. 
Each instantiation creates a separate function in the compiled code. 

Template instantiation happens at compile time, not runtime. 
The compiler generates the actual code for each template specialization used in your program. 
This means templates have zero runtime overhead - they're purely a compile-time feature. 

To understand how templates are instantiated, you can use compiler flags to dump intermediate representations. 
The g++ compiler provides the -fdump-tree-gimple flag, which generates a GIMPLE intermediate representation file. 
GIMPLE is a simplified intermediate language that shows the code after template instantiation but before final optimization. 

To use this, compile your code with: g++ -fdump-tree-gimple your_template_code.cpp. 
This generates a file named your_template_code.cpp.001t.gimple (or similar). 
This file shows the template code after all template parameters have been replaced with actual types. 

In the GIMPLE output, you'll see the instantiated functions with their concrete types. 
For example, a template function template<typename T> void foo(T x) called with int becomes void foo(int x) in the GIMPLE output. 
This helps you understand exactly what code the compiler generates from your templates. 

The GIMPLE representation also shows how the compiler handles template specialization. 
If you have both a general template and a specialized version, you can see which one is used for each call. 
This is valuable for debugging template-related issues and understanding template resolution. 

Template instantiation can lead to code bloat if the same template is instantiated with many different types. 
However, modern compilers are good at deduplicating identical instantiations. 
The -fdump-tree-gimple output helps you see how many instantiations are actually generated. 

Understanding template instantiation is crucial for writing efficient template code. 
By examining the generated code, you can optimize your templates and avoid unnecessary instantiations.
textTranslate:
C++ 中的模板是用于生成代码的编译时机制。 
当你使用具有特定类型的模板时，编译器会生成该模板的专门化版本。 
这个过程称为模板实例化。 

例如，如果你有一个模板函数 max<T>(T a, T b)，并且你调用 max(5, 10)，编译器会实例化 max<int>。 
类似地，调用 max(3.14, 2.71) 会实例化 max<double>。 
每个实例化在编译的代码中创建一个单独的函数。 

模板实例化发生在编译时，而不是运行时。 
编译器为程序中使用的每个模板特化生成实际代码。 
这意味着模板具有零运行时开销——它们纯粹是编译时特性。 

要理解模板是如何实例化的，你可以使用编译器标志来转储中间表示。 
g++ 编译器提供 -fdump-tree-gimple 标志，它生成一个 GIMPLE 中间表示文件。 
GIMPLE 是一种简化的中间语言，显示模板实例化之后但在最终优化之前的代码。 

要使用它，请使用以下命令编译你的代码：g++ -fdump-tree-gimple your_template_code.cpp。 
这会生成一个名为 your_template_code.cpp.001t.gimple（或类似）的文件。 
该文件显示所有模板参数都被实际类型替换后的模板代码。 

在 GIMPLE 输出中，你将看到具有具体类型的实例化函数。 
例如，一个模板函数 template<typename T> void foo(T x) 用 int 调用后，在 GIMPLE 输出中变成 void foo(int x)。 
这有助于你准确理解编译器从模板生成的代码。 

GIMPLE 表示还显示编译器如何处理模板特化。 
如果你同时有通用模板和特化版本，你可以看到每个调用使用哪一个。 
这对于调试与模板相关的问题和理解模板解析很有价值。 

如果同一个模板用许多不同的类型实例化，模板实例化可能导致代码膨胀。 
但是，现代编译器擅长去重相同的实例化。 
-fdump-tree-gimple 输出帮助你查看实际生成了多少个实例化。 

理解模板实例化对于编写高效的模板代码至关重要。 
通过检查生成的代码，你可以优化模板并避免不必要的实例化。
